args.notes: Browser-verified 2026-10-01 via TinyFish: Mayflower Talent Pool is live and the Recruit.ee application form is usable. Page location is Cyprus; the Talent Pool page itself does not state remote, visa, work-authorization or relocation eligibility. Required form fields include CV, Telegram, WhatsApp, country, net monthly salary expectation in EUR, English level, and a short self-introduction/portfolio. Mayflower's company careers site advertises Cyprus relocation support generally, but that is not explicit eligibility for this Talent Pool submission.
